name: Neon FX
author: ClipPolish community
description: A glowing neon edge for any element, a jelly wobble you can drop on titles and stickers, and a snappy “whip” easing curve.

effects.name: Neon edge
effects.description: Glowing outline around the element's shape
effects.glsl: vec4 effect(vec2 uv) { vec2 t = 1.0 / uSize; float e = length(vec2(src(uv + vec2(t.x,0.0)).a - src(uv - vec2(t.x,0.0)).a, src(uv + vec2(0.0,t.y)).a - src(uv - vec2(0.0,t.y)).a)); vec4 o = src(uv); return o + vec4(tint.rgb, 1.0) * clamp(e * strength, 0.0, 1.0) * (1.0 - o.a * 0.5); }

behaviors.name: Jelly
behaviors.description: Squishes in and settles, like jelly
